# P36.73 — Sub-round 11C acceptance: `live`-read sweep + GATE-G6 packet (row 419, capstone)

**Contract:** `docs/tickets/419_P36.73__sub-round-11c-acceptance.md` · **base:** `r11/PLAN-11D-contracts-for-11d-and-tail` · **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent · **`live_verification=false`** (read-only stage; the promoted release does not exist — nothing promoted, hosted, deployed or published by this row)

## Summary

The sub-round 11C capstone. Two deliverables, both honest about what exists:

1. **The live-read sweep machinery** — `sig-ops acceptance-sweep-11c` (new `ops/acceptance_11c.py` + CLI verb + tests): a read-only sweep over the promoted core-surfaces surface once it exists (routes resolve, wire-byte budgets, labels, changelog + mirrors, search-resolve, rate-limit headers, withdrawals, dossiers, parity, disclosures, tiles — all caller-supplied routes, no 200 ever inferred). Its gate reads the RETURN PASS map: while `P36.72b-promote` is queued it refuses (exit 42) and writes a **suppressed** `sig.probe-run/1` — committed now at `docs/build/reports/acceptance/11C-probe-run.json`. Suppressed is never a pass; the leg stays queued for the OM-19 re-run.
2. **The GATE-G6 packet draft** — `docs/build/tools/gate_packet_11c.py` drafts `docs/build/readouts/GATE-G6.md` in the S5-2 shape (sha256-labelled agent-drafted block; every line shows its non-action Default; batch vs verbatim classes per contract 420): budget lines, what 11C published, ING-GO-D + the Wave-D flip list (the plan cell's verbatim set — carried, never answered), PLAN-11D's 15-row draft 11D OM-20 list quoted verbatim with `expires: GATE-ACCEPT-R11`, the Class R standing-go renewal question, and the status part. It decides nothing and signs nothing.
3. **The 11C acceptance note** — `docs/build/tools/acceptance_report_11c.py` generates `docs/build/reports/acceptance/11C.md`: every chain row 344–420 at its honest highest layer (never above its BUILD_INDEX evidence), the six S2 §4.3 exit items each verdicted `queued` with the legs that evaluate them, the derived open-issues list (D-P36.* lead tokens + carried rows + recorded incidents), and the due/window-opened leg evaluation.
